items.question: Should a wise disciple refrain from bowing to his own guru while in the guru's presence?
premises: The context concerns proper conduct in the guru's presence.
A wise disciple is the subject of the prescribed behavior.
The act under consideration is bowing to one's own guru.
items.inference: A wise disciple should not bow to his own guru when already in the guru's presence.
items.plain_english: A wise person should not bow to his own guru while in the guru's presence.
